title: The Ball of Garden Twine
youtube_title: The Ball of Garden Twine | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Niko sees that a ball of garden twine for two bean rows will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Niko makes a smaller, even share so Walid is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
